# Yoosr

> Yoosr is an AI-powered customer support platform with a visual bot builder, knowledge base RAG, and omnichannel support for WhatsApp, Telegram, Messenger, and Instagram. Built for small to medium businesses.

## Docs

- [Visual Bot Builder](https://yoosr.co/en/#features): Drag-and-drop interface for creating customer support workflows without code, with conditional logic, AI blocks, and node-based flow design.
- [Knowledge Base with RAG](https://yoosr.co/en/#features): Upload documents, URLs, and files to power AI responses with retrieval-augmented generation and vector embeddings.
- [Omnichannel Support](https://yoosr.co/en/#channels): Connect WhatsApp, Telegram, Facebook Messenger, and Instagram DMs into a unified inbox for customer conversations.
- [How It Works](https://yoosr.co/en/#how-it-works): Step-by-step walkthrough of setting up a Yoosr project, connecting integrations, and going live with AI-powered support.
- [Who It's For](https://yoosr.co/en/#who-its-for): Overview of target users including e-commerce businesses, SaaS companies, and support teams across multiple industries.
- [Pricing](https://yoosr.co/en/pricing): Details the pricing tiers, feature comparison, and plan limits for different business sizes.

## Products

- [Design Studio](https://yoosr.co/en/design-studio): Visual bot builder for creating and editing conversational AI flows with a node-based editor, AI model selection, and conditional branching.
- [Web Chat Widget](https://yoosr.co/en/#channels): Embeddable chat widget for websites that connects to the same unified inbox as messaging channels.

## Solutions

- [E-commerce Support Automation](https://yoosr.co/en/solutions/ecommerce): Order management, automated responses, and multi-channel customer support for online stores.
- [SaaS Customer Support](https://yoosr.co/en/solutions/saas): In-app support, ticketing, and self-service knowledge base for software companies.

## Resources

- [Trust & Security](https://yoosr.co/en/#trust-signals): Details on data encryption, per-integration webhook security, multi-tenant isolation, and SOC 2 compliance.
- [Supported Channels Overview](https://yoosr.co/en/apps): List of all supported integrations including WhatsApp Business API, Telegram bots, Facebook Messenger, and Instagram.

## About

- [About Yoosr](https://yoosr.co/en): AI-powered customer support platform enabling businesses to automate support across messaging channels with visual bot building and knowledge base RAG.

## Legal

- [Privacy Policy](https://yoosr.co/en/legal/privacy): Data collection, processing, retention, and user rights under GDPR and applicable regulations.
- [Terms of Service](https://yoosr.co/en/legal/terms): Terms governing use of the Yoosr platform, account policies, and liability limitations.

## Key Facts

- Platform name: Yoosr
- Domain: yoosr.co
- Industry: AI-powered customer support / conversational AI
- Supported languages: English, Arabic, French
- Supported channels: WhatsApp Business API, Telegram, Facebook Messenger, Instagram DMs, Web Widget
- Key features: Visual bot builder, knowledge base RAG, team collaboration, analytics dashboard, order management, multi-tenant auth
- Backend: Convex (serverless database, real-time sync)
- Auth: Clerk (multi-tenant, role-based access)
- AI providers: OpenAI (primary), Hugging Face (embeddings)

## Contact

- Website: https://yoosr.co
